responsibility: Provides the main RTL scheduling pass drivers and region-level scheduling framework. It discovers scheduling regions and their block order, manages interblock/speculative scheduling policy, tracks per-region CFG and DFA state, coordinates the first and second scheduling passes (including superblock/EBB variants and selective-scheduling fallbacks), and registers the sched1, sched2, fusion, and live-range-shrinkage RTL passes. Unlike haifa-sched.c’s generic engine, this file is the top-level region scheduler and pass integration layer.
